research_notes: VERIFIED directly: eligibility (Türkiye/TRNC-enrolled high school students); application via TYBS (tybs.tubitak.gov.tr); that the most recently announced cycle is explicitly the '57th' edition, announced 2025-10-14 as 'starting for 2026' (TÜBİTAK's own naming convention labels the 2025-2026 academic-year cycle as its '2026' call); and participation scale for that cycle (29,739 project applications, 52,045 students, per TÜBİTAK's own Jan 28, 2026 preliminary-results announcement). DATE-TRAP CAUGHT: I independently confirmed, by fetching BİDEB's live 'currently open programs' page directly on 2026-08-21, that 2204-A is NOT among the programs currently open for application -- only 2247-B, 2213-A and 2250 appear there. Combined with the sibling 2204-B page's own statement that its most recent cycle's national final exhibition already concluded by 2026-04-30, this means the 57th-edition cycle is FULLY OVER, and no evidence was found anywhere (TÜBİTAK's own site or search) of a 58th/2026-2027 call having been published yet. I have therefore deliberately left `deadline` and `application_open_date` null rather than restating the 2025-2026 cycle's now-irrelevant historical dates as if they were current or upcoming -- those historical dates are recorded only in `program_dates`, clearly labeled as belonging to the concluded 57th cycle. CONFLICTING EVIDENCE: a prior, separate research file already present in this repo (night1_2026-08-21_groupCANADA-TURKEY-EU.jsonl, not authored by me this session) states the 57th-cycle deadline as 'Dec 12, 2025'; a WebSearch snippet aggregating third-party MEB district-office pages this session suggested 'Dec 19, 2025' instead. I did not independently fetch a TÜBİTAK primary page stating the exact deadline day for the 57th cycle (only PDF call texts exist for this, and PDF text extraction failed via the tooling available to me), so I record this conflict rather than picking either figure, and did not put either date in the `deadline` field regardless since that cycle is over. NOT VERIFIED / left null: team size and whether an advisor teacher is mandatory (these live in PDF project-guide documents -- https://tubitak.gov.tr/sites/default/files/2025-10/2204_A_cagri_metni_2025-2026_08.10.2025.pdf and the accompanying proje rehberi PDF -- which returned binary/unparseable content through the available WebFetch tooling; these values were not guessed); specific prize amounts for 2204-A (unlike 2204-C, no cash-prize figure was found on any page fetched); city/venue (the sibling 2204-B page confirms Ankara for ITS final, but no explicit same-city statement was found on a 2204-A-specific page, so this was left null rather than assuming the two run identically).
